note: Authoritative professional-plan registry. The workbook is a view; current delivery state comes only from status.yaml and linked evidence.

advocate_standards.observable: Separates fact, allegation, inference and law; states what is known and unknown; corrects the record visibly.
advocate_standards.failure: Invented or embellished fact, authority or confidence, or a silently changed earlier position.

advocate_standards.observable: Exercises professional judgment, explains disagreement and refuses an unlawful, misleading or improper course.
advocate_standards.failure: Acts as a mouthpiece or hides adverse law or evidence to reach the requested conclusion.

advocate_standards.observable: Knows who instructs, who decides and which acts require client, junior, AOR, senior counsel, filing or administrative authority.
advocate_standards.failure: Accepts direct or unauthorised instructions, exceeds scope, files or concedes without recorded authority.

advocate_standards.observable: Uses only authorised matter material, preserves privilege boundaries and prevents residual or cross-matter disclosure.
advocate_standards.failure: Cross-matter retrieval, uncontrolled processing, residual intake or unexplained external disclosure.

advocate_standards.observable: Recognises limits, protects urgent rights, tracks deadlines, prepares thoroughly and follows work through completion.
advocate_standards.failure: Misses an urgent step, implies competence it lacks or leaves work without an owner or review point.

advocate_standards.observable: Accepts spoken, typed and uploaded accounts, reflects the instruction accurately and makes correction easy.
advocate_standards.failure: Forces retyping or converts transcription or OCR uncertainty into fact.

advocate_standards.observable: Uses calm, neutral and accessible language and preserves the user's agency while remaining objective.
advocate_standards.failure: Blames, pressures, trivialises, lectures or exploits vulnerability.

advocate_standards.observable: Leads with the practical answer and separates conclusion, fact, evidence, authority, risk and next action.
advocate_standards.failure: Buries the answer in telemetry or leaves the user unsure what to do.

advocate_standards.observable: Asks the smallest question most likely to change characterisation, urgency, remedy, proof or action and explains why.
advocate_standards.failure: Uses a fixed questionnaire, repeats known facts or asks immaterial questions because a field is empty.

advocate_standards.observable: Remembers instructions and corrections, preserves versions and gives every material task an owner and review point.
advocate_standards.failure: Forgets prior answers, loses work on retry or leaves a decision without follow-through.

advocate_standards.observable: Finds the questions that control outcome and orders them by threshold effect, urgency and dependency.
advocate_standards.failure: Produces a generic issue list, works immaterial points first or misses a dispositive threshold.

advocate_standards.observable: Distinguishes instruction, allegation, admission, document, testimony, transcript, inference and assumption and assesses evidential use.
advocate_standards.failure: Treats an extracted sentence, transcript or allegation as established truth.

advocate_standards.observable: Uses governing law, date, binding hierarchy, treatment and proposition and verifies primary authority.
advocate_standards.failure: Relies on a stale, non-binding, overruled or propositionally irrelevant authority.

advocate_standards.observable: Tests competing causes and defences and the opponent's strongest coherent case; accounts for material adverse facts.
advocate_standards.failure: Confirms the preferred theory or caricatures the opponent's case.

advocate_standards.observable: Names assumptions, reservations, material uncertainty and what would change the view; withholds unsafe conclusions.
advocate_standards.failure: Uses confidence theatre, gives false certainty or silently fills an evidential gap.

advocate_standards.observable: Tests whether useful relief exists, can be obtained in time and can realistically be enforced.
advocate_standards.failure: Recommends a legally arguable claim whose remedy is unavailable, hollow or too late.

advocate_standards.observable: Balances value, urgency, cost, delay, evidential burden, disruption and likelihood of useful recovery.
advocate_standards.failure: Recommends maximum legal action without regard to objective or economics.

advocate_standards.observable: Connects law and proof to sequencing, leverage, negotiation, settlement authority and likely behaviour without presenting speculation as fact.
advocate_standards.failure: Provides only doctrinal law or makes unsupported predictions about judges, opponents or settlement.

advocate_standards.observable: Reduces the file to a coherent theory, precise propositions, record locators, answers to hard questions and the form required for conference or court.
advocate_standards.failure: Produces a data dump, unsupported rhetoric or an argument that cannot be located in the record.

advocate_standards.observable: Acts within authority, uses the approved version, verifies transmission or filing and reports failure honestly through closure.
advocate_standards.failure: Treats a recommendation as authority, uses the wrong version or reports success without confirmation.

workflow_states.purpose: Know the decision or work product, who instructs, who decides, the deadline, forum, scope and objective.
Prevent irreversible harm and professional error before ordinary analysis.
workflow_states.required_output: Protective action or recorded refusal with outstanding screens visible.

workflow_states.purpose: Let the user speak or upload rather than retype and retrieve authorised matter material first.
workflow_states.required_output: Source inventory with immutable originals, derived text, provenance and processing state.

workflow_states.purpose: Understand the account without treating every statement as established fact.
workflow_states.required_output: Versioned factual account, chronology, parties, threads and proposition/source map.

workflow_states.purpose: Use early legal judgment to decide what matters next without presenting premature advice.
workflow_states.required_output: Ranked working hypotheses with predicates and explicit uncertainty.

workflow_states.purpose: Ask the smallest useful question or request that can materially change the legal or practical position.
workflow_states.required_output: Question or request with purpose, expected effect and response state.

workflow_states.purpose: Know when enough is known for the specific task without pretending the matter is complete.
workflow_states.required_output: Named readiness state with open gaps, assumptions and expiry or review trigger.

workflow_states.purpose: Resolve the legal, procedural and evidential questions that control outcome.
workflow_states.required_output: Versioned legal position with support, dependencies and reservations.

workflow_states.purpose: Test the preferred theory against the strongest alternative and the client's real objective.
workflow_states.required_output: Options and scenario record with practical consequences and decision points.

workflow_states.purpose: Give the answer in a form whose certainty and completeness match the state of the file.
workflow_states.required_output: AM-01 to AM-05 output with support, uncertainty and next step.

workflow_states.purpose: Preserve client or advocate autonomy and prevent a recommendation becoming unauthorised action.
workflow_states.required_output: Decision, authority scope, owner, expiry and next review point.

workflow_states.purpose: Execute the authorised step accurately and report actual outcome rather than intention.
workflow_states.required_output: Verified action event, resulting obligation and updated file state.

workflow_states.purpose: Maintain continuity, respond to new events and close only when obligations are resolved.
workflow_states.required_output: Current matter state, handover package, closure record or reopened task.

advice_maturity.when_permitted: An urgent and potentially irreversible position exists before ordinary screening can finish.
advice_maturity.must_not_imply: A full merits opinion or authority beyond the emergency step.

advice_maturity.when_permitted: The commission is known but the brief is not ready for a concluded legal view.
advice_maturity.must_not_imply: That the issues are complete or a recommended course has been reached.

advice_maturity.when_permitted: Material analysis is possible but named assumptions or gaps could change it.
advice_maturity.must_not_imply: Considered advice or certainty beyond the identified support.

advice_maturity.when_permitted: The task-specific brief and legal work pass their readiness gates.
advice_maturity.must_not_imply: Authority to act or certainty of litigation outcome.

advice_maturity.when_permitted: A considered decision and the required professional authority have been recorded.
advice_maturity.must_not_imply: Permission to expand scope, concede, settle, file or communicate beyond recorded authority.

roles.may: Provide and correct facts, objectives and constraints and make decisions reserved to the client.
roles.controlled: Identity, authority to instruct, consent and matter relationship must be recorded.

roles.may: Take instructions, classify material, research, obtain authority, prepare the brief and coordinate action.
roles.controlled: Cannot misstate instructions, conceal adverse material or delegate beyond authority.

roles.may: File and act in the Supreme Court and coordinate procedural work with arguing counsel.
roles.controlled: Client authority, court rules, approved version and filing receipt govern action.

roles.may: Frame issues, test law and evidence, advise the instructing team and argue within the recorded brief.
roles.controlled: Instruction route, role restrictions, concessions and settlement authority remain configurable and explicit.

roles.may: Retrieve, summarise, cite and organise material for a bounded supervised task.
roles.controlled: Cannot give unreviewed advice, make client decisions or alter source material.

roles.may: Transmit, file, serve, schedule and record operational events within an approved package.
roles.controlled: Cannot alter substance, select an unapproved version or report success without a receipt.

roles.may: Manage identity, roles, availability, retention configuration and audited support access.
roles.controlled: No routine substantive matter access; support access is segregated, necessary, attributable and expiring.

gap_closures.gap: Commission and task framing is scattered
gap_closures.plan_change: Make EW-01 mandatory before substantive work and on a material new instruction.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Role, decision sought, scope, objective, deadline and requested output persist and rerun on change.

gap_closures.plan_change: Use the role matrix for permissions, handoffs and refusal states.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Every material instruction and action is allowed, delegated or refused by role and recorded authority.

gap_closures.plan_change: Use EW-05 and EW-06 to rank the next question by expected decision impact and user burden.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: The next question changes with the legal hypothesis and never repeats known or retrievable information.

gap_closures.gap: Intake lacks first-class voice and mixed-media input
gap_closures.plan_change: Support live voice, audio, video, images and common documents with resumable processing and user correction.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: The original is preserved and every transcript or OCR proposition has a locator, confidence and confirmation state.

gap_closures.gap: Fact and evidence states are too coarse
gap_closures.plan_change: Use a typed proposition and source model across intake and legal analysis.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Every material conclusion traces to a typed proposition and source locator; contradictions remain visible.

gap_closures.plan_change: Represent the legal file as a dependency graph with selective invalidation and versioned recomputation.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Changing a predicate invalidates all dependent conclusions and no unrelated conclusion; prior states remain auditable.

gap_closures.plan_change: Add relief, prerequisites, enforcement route, assets, timing and practical recovery to the legal file and advice.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Golden matters include strong merits with unavailable, hollow or disproportionate relief and the recommendation changes.

gap_closures.gap: Advice has no formal maturity model
gap_closures.plan_change: Require every output to declare AM-01 to AM-05 and satisfy its readiness and content contract.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: A preliminary or provisional view cannot read as considered advice and changes state when a blocking predicate changes.

gap_closures.gap: Practical and settlement judgment is incomplete
gap_closures.plan_change: Add comparable options, strategy and settlement decision points, authority and do-nothing consequences.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Equivalent legal merits produce different recommendations when practical constraints change, with reasons visible.

gap_closures.gap: Trust-building interaction is not an explicit acceptance surface
gap_closures.plan_change: Evaluate PA-01 to PA-10 across the served journey and keep material failures visible.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Representative users can identify what NM understood, used, assumed, changed, needs and will do next.

gap_closures.gap: Recommendation and authority to act are not separated sharply
gap_closures.plan_change: Require EW-11 and the role-specific authority matrix before every external or irreversible action.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Every action has an authorised role, scope, approved version, owner, deadline and receipt; missing authority blocks success.

gap_closures.gap: Senior-advocate quality is not measured end to end
gap_closures.plan_change: Use the Advocate Standard as the counsel gate with named reviewers, representative matters, thresholds and reservations.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: No counsel-facing feature conforms without current review across all applicable PA standards.

gap_closures.gap: The underlying 47-step system may become the user experience
gap_closures.plan_change: Build the workspace around understanding, purpose, change, readiness, decisions and next action with deeper evidence inspectable.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: At each target width an advocate can reorient in under one minute without reading engineering state.

gap_closures.gap: Multimodal processing adds confidentiality and integrity risk
gap_closures.plan_change: Apply purpose, authority, least privilege, quarantine, processor, retention and deletion controls before media reaches legal reasoning.
gap_closures.minimum_acceptance: Unsafe media never enters reasoning; processing boundaries are disclosed and controlled; originals, derivatives and deletion remain attributable.
